summary: SU Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K and press release announcing that on August 3, 2026, Nasdaq issued a Staff Determination to delist its Class A ordinary shares from the Nasdaq Capital Market due to the bid price closing below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days (June 18 to July 31, 2026). The company intends to request a hearing before a Nasdaq Hearings Panel, which will stay suspension and Form 25 filing pending decision. A shareholder-approved 1-for-5 share consolidation expected August 6, 2026 may restore compliance. Watch: whether the consolidation sustains bid price above $1.00 and Panel outcome.
